t: mw_run.main is the CLI engine entry behind "python3 -m metaviewer_agents.mw_run": it parses flags, validates mode combinations, loads tools/mw_run_backend.py by file path via importlib, computes a wall deadline, and calls runner(args) (default host.run_entry) under a RefusalOutput stdout proxy and the wall_deadline context.

build_parser defines the closed CLI: required --identity; --site/--workflow; --surface-kind browser|program (default browser); --goal; --text; --key in Enter/Up/Down/Left/Right; --steps (default 1); --timeout-ms (default 10000); --planner rules|muse; --model-timeout-ms (default 120000); repeatable --slot. allow_abbrev=False and add_help=False.

Mode exclusivity in main: goal/program mode refuses --site, --workflow or --slot; steps must be 1..16, timeout-ms 1..30000, model-timeout-ms 1..240000, --text 1..65536 UTF-8 bytes; program --key requires --goal focused-key, --steps 1, --planner rules and no --text; browser --key supports only Enter. Stored-workflow browser mode requires --site and --workflow with all program options at their defaults. Violations exit via argparse parser.error (usage exit, not a mw_run/v1 line).

resolve_wall_deadline_s derives the run budget: starts at WALL_DEADLINE_CEILING_S 360.0 s; goal/program mode uses min(ceiling, steps*(3*timeout_ms + model_ms)/1000 + 30 s margin) where model_ms counts only for planner muse; a stored site/workflow is looked up under MV_MW_HOME (or repo memoryweb) then memoryweb-builtin and fed to budget_from_workflow; any OSError/ValueError/KeyError/TypeError falls back to the ceiling; MV_MW_WALL_DEADLINE_S is applied last.

budget_from_workflow = max(site, workflow execution_policy.min_notice_s) + sum over steps of (locate_wait_ms + action.delivery_budget_ms + verify.deadline_ms)/1000 + margin_s; min_notice_s must be an int 0..MAX_NOTICE_S (300), delivery_budget_ms and deadline_ms must be ints >= 1 (bool rejected by type(value) is int), and steps must be a non-empty list, else ValueError.
apply_budget_override can only lower the budget: it returns min(base, override) for a finite positive float and ignores None, blank, non-numeric, non-finite or <= 0 overrides.

wall_deadline arms signal.setitimer(ITIMER_REAL) with a SIGALRM handler that raises WallDeadlineError (code MW_WALL_DEADLINE) on the main thread, and temporarily wraps ReplayOwner.run and check_network; if the deadline expired and the owner result verdict_code is INPUT_UNCERTAIN, the result is rebuilt with the deadline text appended to diagnostic instead of raising, so a possibly delivered input is never reported as retryable. Handler and methods are restored in finally.

_write_fallback_report runs when a custom runner lets WallDeadlineError escape: it prints "mw_run: MW_WALL_DEADLINE: ..." to stderr, creates XDG_STATE_HOME/metaviewer/runs/<uuid>/report.json with mode 0700 dir and O_EXCL 0600 file, and prints a metaviewer.mw_run/v1 line with rc 6; if the evidence path is not absolute, lies inside the repo, has symlinked parents or an OSError occurs, verdict_code becomes MW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT and report is null.

mw_run.py raises or emits these codes itself: MW_WALL_DEADLINE (WallDeadlineError.code, rc WALL_DEADLINE_RC 6) and MW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT (fallback report could not be written safely); budget parsing raises plain ValueError messages such as "invalid integer budget field", "symlinked workflow path", "oversized workflow file" (MAX_WORKFLOW_BYTES 65536).

Callers of mw_run: the terminal deck prompt in ui/src/terminal/terminalDeckModel.js and packaged help text in ui/tools/package.js show "python3 -m metaviewer_agents.mw_run ..."; tools/mw_run_program.py and tools/mw_run_browser_goal.py import resolve_wall_deadline_s; main() itself delegates to tools/mw_run_backend.py run_entry.

mw_refusals attaches exactly one static operator remedy sentence on stderr for each nonzero metaviewer.mw_run/v1 result line, keeping stdout byte-exact; REFUSALS maps about 100 verdict codes (MW_*, HUMAN_HANDOFF, INPUT_UNCERTAIN, OUT_OF_SUPPORT, STALE_FRAME, TORN, etc.) to remedy text.

refusal_sentence returns REFUSALS[code]; any code starting with MW_GATE_ maps to the MW_GATE_ remedy (rerun tools/mw_home_check.py); any other unknown code gets a generic "The runner refused with an unrecognized code; inspect the existing diagnostic and run report..." sentence, so unknown external codes are still treated as refusals.

RefusalOutput.write forwards text to the real stream first and returns its byte count unchanged; it accumulates at most 65536 characters per line, marks longer lines oversized and never interprets them, so the proxy never buffers or alters output.

RefusalOutput._line prints "mw_run refusal <json-quoted code>: <sentence>" to stderr only when a complete line parses as a dict with schema metaviewer.mw_run/v1, an int rc != 0 (type check excludes bool) and a string verdict_code; the code is JSON-encoded with ensure_ascii so unknown codes stay on one line.
RefusalOutput is installed only by mw_run.main via redirect_stdout; refusal_sentence is also imported by tools/mw_run_program.py and tools/mw_run_browser_goal.py.
Remedies for INPUT_UNCERTAIN and MW_WALL_DEADLINE both tell the operator to observe and reconcile capsule state before another input/run, matching the no-retry rule for possibly delivered input.

mw_handoff provides an absorbing human-handoff latch for a run: no solver, retry, reset or resume. HandoffResult is a frozen dataclass (rc, verdict_code, summary, diagnostic, handoff_path) returned by ReplayOwner.run.
HandoffLatch.inspect is absorbing: once latched it returns True for every later call, and it sets latched=True before attempting persistence so a write failure can never reopen admission.

inspect runs the injected detector (or wender.perceive.stopstate.detect) on the existing state/url/frame_urls/headers; additionally an observed.observed_wall dict with observed True and kind login_wall or a challenge wall forces a stop with confidence 100 and evidence kind ax_role_name.

The persisted record is schema metaviewer.handoff/v1 with surface_id, step_index, reason, confidence and sorted evidence_kinds only (no detector evidence values), written as sorted-key JSON plus newline via the caller-supplied write function.

If writing the handoff record raises OSError, inspect sets persisted=False and raises HandoffPersistenceError("handoff latched; artifact persistence failed"), an OSError subclass whose code is MW_HANDOFF_REQUIRED.
HandoffLatch is constructed by ReplayOwner.__init__ at output.with_suffix(".handoff.json") with detector=detect_stopstate from wender_bridge, and also imported by tools/mw_run_browser_goal.py.

mw_home admits a private MemoryWeb home (site data packs) without persisting any browser profile; limits are MAX_ENTRIES 10000, MAX_DEPTH 32, MAX_FILE_BYTES 1 MiB and MAX_WORKFLOW_BYTES 65536 for files under a workflows directory. Unsafe homes are refused, never repaired.
resolve_home defaults to <repo>/memoryweb; an override must be absolute and no path may contain "..", else HomeError MW_HOME_PATH.

_directory walks every ancestor with O_NOFOLLOW|O_DIRECTORY dir-fds from the filesystem root and raises MW_HOME_SYMLINK on any symlink; _mode requires the home to be a directory owned by the current uid with exact mode 0700, else MW_HOME_MODE.

check_home raises MW_HOME_TRACKED (is_tracked predicate true), MW_HOME_CAPACITY (>10000 entries or depth >= 32), MW_HOME_NESTED_REPO (a .git entry), MW_HOME_SYMLINK, MW_HOME_PROFILE (browser profile file names such as Cookies, Login Data, key4.db or their -wal/-shm/-journal companions, profile directories like leveldb, "profile N", or files whose header is SQLite or SQLite WAL magic), MW_HOME_SIZE (file above limit) and MW_HOME_MODE (non-regular entries).

OSError during canonical_home, ensure_home or check_home is mapped to MW_HOME_SYMLINK when errno is ELOOP and MW_HOME_MODE otherwise; canonical_home also refuses MW_HOME_SYMLINK when path.resolve() differs from the lexical path. The caller sees the code in the mw_run/v1 line and a stderr hint to run tools/mw_home_check.py.

site_root selects a whole site: a site id must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63} (else MW_SITE_ID); if <home>/sites/<site> exists it must be a directory (else MW_SITE_PATH) and the home is returned; otherwise the read-only <repo>/memoryweb-builtin is returned if it has the site, else MW_SITE_MISSING. Symlinked candidate paths refuse MW_HOME_SYMLINK.
mw_home functions are called by tools/mw_run_backend.py (admit_home, stage_corpus via site_root), tools/mw_home_check.py main, and tools/mv_demo.py (site_root).

ensure_home creates only the final directory with mode 0700 relative to an O_NOFOLLOW parent fd (parents must already exist), tolerates FileExistsError, then re-opens it and enforces _mode; an existing 0755 home is refused, not chmodded.

mw_owner.ReplayOwner is the custodied owner object handed to the pinned wender-agent workflow runner (separate proprietary program, imported from its locked checkout): it implements artifact, authorization, observations, transport, journal and slots seams via owners(); it has no native input capability itself and dispatches only through backend.call("propose").

need(value, code="OUT_OF_SUPPORT") raises OwnerRefused(code); OwnerRefused subclasses ValueError and carries .code. RebindHandoff is an OwnerRefused with code MW_HANDOFF_REQUIRED that carries fresh sensed evidence.

Corpus loads site.json and workflows/<id>.json read-only: selector must match a/b (MW_SELECTOR), the bundled mw.v1 schema must hash to gate.SCHEMA_PIN (MW_SCHEMA_PIN), each schema projection must equal the pinned $defs, each document must be byte-canonical (MW_CANONICAL) and conform (MW_SCHEMA), ids must agree (MW_IDENTITY); file sha256 pins are kept and intact() rechecks them.

check_network refuses MW_NETWORK when the backend call raises, the reply is not a dict, replay lacks fixtures_offline True, or site mode declares a mode other than open, allowlisted/proxied or legacy, or the declared mode changes during the run. check_notice refuses MW_NOTICE (missing/unacknowledged/future notice or min_notice_s not yet elapsed), MW_RESTART (allow_capsule_restart) and MW_WRITE_APPROVAL (requires_operator_go_ahead_on_write).

sense refuses MW_DEADLINE when past deadline, MW_FRAME_BINDING when observe/perceive frame, table hash and witness disagree, MW_STALE_PUBLICATION when a frame goes backwards in generation or changes pixels at the same generation versus the last publication or receipt, MW_AX on a malformed AX tree and MW_CAPACITY above peak_bytes; it also runs stop_check on every acquisition.

stop_check raises mw._Stop("HUMAN_HANDOFF", 4, "MW_HANDOFF_REQUIRED") when the HandoffLatch detects a wall; handoff_guard then refuses MW_HANDOFF_REQUIRED on every later sense/action/send so a latched capsule is never polled or driven again (check("commit") only persists).

supports limits stored workflows to draft status, T1 ax: element anchors (target_supported) and state_signal truth predicates on mv.ax.present.v1/mv.ax.focus.v1; it refuses type and wait_signal actions, non-coordinate paths, fallback targets, when/repeat, and key/paste without a focus precondition. validate_corpus turns a false result into MW_UNSUPPORTED_WORKFLOW (or the MW_TEXT_UNPRINTABLE:/MW_SLOT_MISSING: slot code) and a gate failure into "MW_GATE_" + category.

send refuses MW_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED unless check("send") just ran, MW_FOCUS when type/key lacks exactly one focused AX row, MW_ADMISSION_BINDING when the admitted verdict proposal_id differs, and MW_RECEIPT_MISMATCH unless wait_verify reports verified with matching proposal_id, surface_id, input_mono_ns inside [boundary, now], focus_verified, after_frame sha and receipt_binding_negative_control PASS. Only the binding metadata is retained in receipts.

run(): handoff_guard, validate_corpus, check_network, then runs mw.run_workflow (or readback_runner(mw, self)); refuses MW_SLOT_READBACK_DEADLINE if the readback window expired; returns HandoffResult with handoff_path only when the latch persisted, and forces rc 4 HUMAN_HANDOFF when a pre-submission RebindHandoff latched. recover always answers False (no resume, uncertain input never retried) and stage allows outstanding intent only in a failure summary (rc != 0, else MW_JOURNAL).

Corpus, ReplayOwner, OwnerRefused, RebindHandoff, bounded_read, need and focus_only_steps are imported by tools/mw_run_backend.py; mw_run.wall_deadline patches ReplayOwner.run/check_network only if metaviewer_agents.mw_owner is already in sys.modules.

tools/mw_run_backend.py is the host side of mw_run: run_entry dispatches program mode to tools/mw_run_program.py and goal mode to tools/mw_run_browser_goal.py; stored-workflow browser runs admit the MemoryWeb home, create a private evidence dir, connect to the core, build HostBackend and call execute().

run_entry always ends by printing one compact metaviewer.mw_run/v1 JSON line {schema, rc, verdict_code, receipt, report} and returning rc; report.json (0600, O_EXCL) also gets message, network evidence and the trace. If writing report.json fails, report becomes null and rc/verdict become 6/MW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT unless rc was 4 or 5.

run_entry default is rc 6 MW_RUN_CONFIG; caught exceptions keep their .code or .reason_code, subprocess.TimeoutExpired becomes MW_RUN_NATIVE, ClientError becomes MW_RUN_CORE, DependencyLockError becomes MW_DEPENDENCY, HomeError messages point at tools/mw_home_check.py; a "mw_run: CODE: message" line goes to stderr. Before any core connection the evidence dir XDG_STATE_HOME/metaviewer/runs/<uuid> must be absolute, outside repo and home, symlink-free and 0700 per level, else MW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT.

attach_env/discover_attach/connect raise MW_RUN_ATTACH when no or more than one packaged app adapter (resources/bin/mv-daemon-adapter whose parent is the app metaviewer binary, same uid) is found, when it exposes no MV_CORE_CONFIG/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, when a caller ATTACH_KEYS value differs, when paths are not absolute, the config is unreadable or core.sock is absent; connect raises MW_RUN_REGISTRATION unless exactly one agent peer (optionally MV_AGENT_INSTANCE) is registered.

HostBackend.ownership refuses MW_IDENTITY (admin show mismatch), MW_RUN_NO_SURFACE / MW_RUN_AMBIGUOUS (zero or several active surfaces or live Docker capsule leases for the identity), MW_RUN_OWNERSHIP (Docker inventory failed, or surface/capsule changed during the run) and MW_PROGRAM_CONTROL when agent control is required but the surface control is not agent. HostBackend.__init__ refuses MW_RUN_CONFIG when MV_SRF_STATE_DIR, MV_SRF_BIN_DIR or SRF_IDENTITY_STORE_ROOT is unset or not absolute and MW_COMPILED_BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE for a compiled wender-agent; native() admits only "srf-identity-surface ax" and "srf-identity-admin show" (else MW_RUN_NATIVE_INPUT) and refuses MW_RUN_NATIVE on nonzero exit or over 1 MiB output.

network_context proves the capsule network mode only from the adapter start witness egress/<identity>.started.json (mode 0400, schema metaviewer.capsule_egress_started/v1, matching capsule_id, effective_mode open/proxied/legacy, record_sha256 equal to the current egress record or "absent"); any mismatch refuses MW_NETWORK with "network setting changed after start or start witness unavailable; restart the capsule". proxied is reported as allowlisted/proxied.

propose re-perceives and rebinds before each submission; only MW_REBIND_PIXELS (no proposal sent) or a core STALE_FRAME refusal permits another attempt, at most 3 when sensed has AX, within the original max_ms; otherwise the refusal is raised, and exhausting attempts or budget refuses MW_STALE_FRAME_EXHAUSTED.

execute(): stage_corpus (copies the whole site plus pinned builtin schemas into evidence/corpus when the root lacks standards/schemas), focus_corpus projection, network_context, wait_notice (announces on stderr and sleeps max min_notice_s, refusing MW_NOTICE above 300), then ReplayOwner(mode site).run(); a handoff returns (4, HUMAN_HANDOFF, path); missing receipt with rc 0 refuses "receipt path absent"; a receipt that differs from result.summary or fails the run schema/gate refuses MW_RUN_RECEIPT.

state_for prefers the compiled wender state entry; otherwise it runs the tools/gate_g_ai.py WENDER_SHIM in a child Python with cwd at the wender checkout and env PATH, PYTHONPATH and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, refusing MW_RUN_STATE on nonzero exit. This child is the only place in these files that disables bytecode writing.

tools/mw_run_backend.py is loaded by file path from mw_run.main (module name mv_mw_run_backend, runner = host.run_entry) and imported as a module by tools/mw_run_program.py, tools/mw_run_browser_goal.py and tools/mw_ax_dump.py, which reuse its HostBackend and helpers.

tools/mw_home_check.py is the offline admission CLI for a MemoryWeb home: --repo (required), --home, --workflow SITE/WORKFLOW; it prints one metaviewer.mw_home/v1 JSON line {schema, home, ok, code[, faults]} and exits 0, 2 for MW_HOME_PATH, or 6 for other refusals.

main refuses MW_HOME_GIT (git errors or timeout 10 s), MW_HOME_TRACKED, MW_HOME_NOT_IGNORED, MW_HOME_PATH (bad --workflow selector), MW_WORKFLOW_ABSENT (workflow file missing) and MW_PROVENANCE (provenance faults), plus all mw_home check_home codes; unlike mw_run admission it calls ensure_home and so creates a missing home with mode 0700.

provenance_faults returns one actionable line per site.json/workflow provenance reference the pinned gate cannot open: source_ref (before #) must be a relative regular non-symlink file inside sites/<site>/ without ".", "..", ":", "\\" or "?", and a non-human source must pin receipt_sha256 equal to the file sha256.

packaged_runtime is true only when the repo has no .git and has runtime.manifest.json; the seal must be schema metaviewer.operator-runtime/v1 listing at least deps.lock, VERSION and tools/mw_home_check.py, the home must be outside the repo (MW_HOME_PATH), and every listed file must hash-match (MW_RUNTIME_HASH). It verifies only listed files; extra files are not checked here.

mw_home_check is loaded by file path in tools/mw_run_backend.py (packaged_runtime, provenance_faults used to reword MW_GATE_* refusals) and imported by tools/mv_demo.py, which calls home_check.main and resolve_home.

tools.py is the closed mvctl tool-verb layer: each verb (observe, list_surfaces, propose, wait_verify, plus record_start/record_stop) builds one mv_tool_call/v0.2 body, hands it to an injected client.request(), and validates the mv_tool_result/v0.2 reply; the module never opens sockets and leaves framing, sender identity, sequence, nonce replay and byte caps to the client.

Core refusals are accepted only with reason_code in {STALE_FRAME, SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED, LOCKED_BY_OTHER, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, POLICY}; _raise_refused raises ToolRefusal(reason, None) because the frozen refused branch carries no core_seq, and an unlisted code becomes ToolValidationError('invalid reason_code').

Core error frames map by code: PROTOCOL, UNAVAILABLE and NOT_FOUND raise ToolOperationalError (alias ToolCoreError, a ToolValidationError subclass carrying error_code/error_detail/result); VERIFICATION_FAILED raises VerificationFailed with the deep-copied body; any other code raises ToolValidationError('invalid error code').

Every reply is correlated before interpretation: _check_result_head requires schema exactly mv_tool_result/v0.2 (another mv_tool_result/ version gives 'unknown result version', anything else 'invalid result'), the same random 32-hex request_id that was sent, and the same op, else 'uncorrelated request_id' / 'uncorrelated op'.

wait_verify computes one monotonic deadline (timeout_ms capped at 60000), sends only fresh wait_verify calls carrying the remaining budget, sleeps min(retry_after_ms, remaining) on 'pending', never resubmits the action, raises TimeoutError('wait_verify budget exhausted') when the budget ends, and turns a 'timeout' status (verified=false) into VerificationFailed.

A 'verified' wait result is accepted only if receipt.verified is true, error is empty, focus_verified is true, frame_sha256 equals receipt.after_frame.sha256, native_evidence.input_mono_ns equals the top-level input_mono_ns, and the receipt's after_frame surface matches the requested surface_id; the return is a _VerifiedReceipt dict exposing those witnesses as attributes.

observe() validates the core observation (including observation.validate_observation with contract_version v0.2), checks frame_ref.surface_id equals the requested surface, and when a perception_adapter is passed replaces the vision field with adapter.perceive(frame_ref) and revalidates the whole observation.

record_start sends record_request/v0.2: mode 'ram' (op ram_start) forbids disk destination fields and needs ring_bytes 1..1073741824 and max_fps 1..120; mode 'disk' (op disk_start) forbids ring_bytes and requires destination_capability_id plus an absolute destination_path; the reply must be a correlated 'started' record_event with the same mode, else 'unexpected record_start event'.

record_stop drains at most 256 record_event replies (frame_captured/dropped for RAM, exported for disk) until 'stopped'; any other event gives 'unexpected record_stop event', exceeding the cap gives 'record event stream exceeded cap', and a refused event raises ToolRefusal.

mvctl dispatches its v0.2 subcommands straight onto these verbs (tools.list_surfaces, observe, propose, record_start, record_stop, wait_verify); verify.run_loop also calls observe/propose/wait_verify.

envelope.py is the transport-only codec for agent<->core mailbox frames: it runtime-validates closed envelope/v0.2 (plus capsule_envelope/v0.2, rewind_envelope/v0.2, guest_command_observation_envelope/v0.2) and legacy envelope/v0.1 frames against embedded schema data, refusing unknown versions and enforcing byte caps before any parse or write.

All failures raise EnvelopeError with a fixed code: 'unknown_version' for a well-formed frame naming an outer or body version this build does not speak, 'length' when a frame exceeds the byte cap, and 'bad_shape' for every other deviation (exact outer keys, endpoints, seq>=1, ts_ns>=0, names 1..128 chars, body discriminator).

Body families are partitioned by outer schema: rewind_envelope admits only rewind_request/rewind_event, capsule_envelope only its four capsule bodies, envelope/v0.2 only bodies registered in envelope.schema.json, and envelope/v0.1 only v0.1 bodies; a known family with a non-v0.2 version yields unknown_version, an unknown family bad_shape.

_check_json_values walks the frame iteratively before any schema walk or deepcopy: integers must be within +/-(2**53-1), floats finite, strings free of UTF-16 surrogates and at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes, and container depth at most 32; any violation is reported as bad_shape 'envelope contains invalid JSON values'.

loads_envelope gates byte length before UTF-8 decode, requires a trailing LF (one CR before it is tolerated), refuses blank frames, embedded CR/LF, invalid UTF-8, a pre-scan nesting depth over 32, duplicate object keys and NaN/Infinity literals, then calls validate_envelope.

dumps_envelope validates, then encodes compact JSON with ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False, appends LF, and raises EnvelopeError('length', 'frame exceeds byte cap') when the full frame including terminator exceeds max_bytes; a non-positive or non-int cap is bad_shape.

At import the module deep-copies the generated _contracts_v02.FILES map, rewrites stale '/v0.1' schema consts inside mv_tool_result $defs to '/v0.2' to match the Rust wire/schemas.rs projection, prefixes $refs with 'v0.2/', and asserts the capsule and rewind body registries are exactly the expected sets ('closed capsule body registry mismatch').

The embedded schema subset is audited at import (_audit): only listed keywords, every object must be closed with additionalProperties false, required keys must be declared, patterns must compile; the evaluator _check enforces oneOf exactly-one-match and a recursion depth of 100.

make_envelope picks the outer schema from the body tag (guest_command_observation/v0.2 -> observation envelope, rewind tags -> rewind_envelope, capsule tags -> capsule_envelope, '/v0.1' -> legacy, else envelope/v0.2), defaults nonce to 32 hex chars and ts_ns to monotonic nanoseconds since a module-level session origin, validates, then deep-copies the body.

envelope is consumed by client.py (imports from .envelope), mvctl (validate_envelope, make_envelope), guest_command._handle (validate_envelope on every inbound frame) and rewind._TypedBody (reuses _BODIES/_check/_check_json_values to type rewind bodies).

verify.run_loop is the bounded observe -> plan -> propose-once -> wait_verify workflow; success is only the core's verified receipt, typed exceptions are terminal outcomes, and an action is never replayed.

Planner selection: MV_WENDER_PLANNER_CMD (JSON argv) or provider='wender' forces the Wender planner, which runs as a separate subprocess via WenderSubprocessAdapter; with provider None, Wender is also used when no local planner is passed or a Wender root is configured. The Wender checkout is resolved by resolve_locked_component('wender-agent') and must equal wender_root when given.

run_loop raises ObservationError codes: 'bad_shape' ('provider must be wender or local', 'local planner must return action and expectation'), 'unavailable' ('Wender requires perception evidence', 'Wender checkout is not a directory', 'local planner required'), and 'commit_mismatch' ('verified checkout differs from wender_root').

timeout_ms must be an int in 1..60000 (else ValueError('invalid timeout')); a single monotonic deadline feeds every step via remaining(), which raises TimeoutError('loop deadline exceeded') once it is spent, and the proposal budget max_ms is set to the remaining milliseconds.

If tools.wait_verify raises TypeError, run_loop calls wait_verify again without surface_id (a compatibility path for clients/fakes lacking that keyword); a TypeError raised inside the initial wait therefore triggers another wait poll, not a second proposal.

After wait_verify, run_loop re-checks the receipt: proposal_id and after_frame.surface_id must match the observed surface (ToolValidationError 'uncorrelated proposal_id'/'uncorrelated surface_id'), and a schema-bearing receipt is revalidated with tools._check_receipt_verified.

build_proposal derives action_proposal/v0.2 from a validated frame_ref (surface_id, sha256, generation become based_on_frame) and validates it with tools._check_proposal, so a stale frame is detected by the core as STALE_FRAME rather than locally.
loop_trials imports run_loop and invokes it per trial; wender_bridge reads get_configured_planner_cmd lazily.

observe.py builds and validates agent-side observation/v0.2 (and explicit v0.1) payloads: exactly one frame_ref plus optional closed vision and ground_truth; metadata checks cannot prove frame bytes, freshness or provenance, which stay with the core and adapters. It also provides the geometry-free Holdings battery digest.

ObservationError carries one of three codes: 'unknown_version' (foreign observation or frame_ref version), 'identity_mismatch' (trusted surface_id/generation malformed or frame_ref not matching them: 'frame_ref breaks trusted binding'), and 'bad_shape' for every other deviation.
Every vision bbox (changed_regions and element bboxes) must lie inside the frame: x+w <= width and y+h <= height, else bad_shape '<name> escapes the frame'; frame dimensions are capped at 16384.
frame_ref.ramws_path must match /dev/shm(/segment){1,8}, be 10..255 chars and contain no NUL, else bad_shape 'ramws_path leaves shared memory'; format must be rgb24 and sha256 64 lowercase hex.
Element confidence must be an int or float (bool excluded by exact type) that is finite and within [0, 1], else bad_shape 'confidence outside [0.0, 1.0]'.

The default contract_version is a _DefaultVersion('v0.2') sentinel; build_observation downgrades to v0.1 only when the version was omitted, frame_ref is frame_ref/v0.1, vision is given and ground_truth is absent, preserving legacy perception-only callers.
validate_observation converts a RecursionError into bad_shape 'observation nesting exceeds limit', and build_observation validates before deep-copying so hostile nesting fails closed before any copy.

compute_battery_state_sha256 clones state['nodes'], sets each node['box'] to None, and hashes canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8); floats, surrogates, non-string keys and depth over 32 are refused. The digest is distinct from the core state_sha256 witness.

tools._check_observation calls validate_observation with the frame's own surface_id/generation and contract_version 'v0.2', re-raising the message as ToolValidationError; vision.py also imports validate_observation.

rewind.py provides RewindSession: REWIND pause/resume/mark/restore requests sent through the existing guest-command IO owner (its lock, queue, pump thread and ToolClient); it issues no native actions and opens no second connection.

Callers reach RewindSession through ToolClient.rewind, which returns guest_commands.rewind; GuestCommandSession creates it at claim time when observe_owned is true and routes every rewind_event/v0.2 body to RewindSession._handle.

RewindSession.start raises RewindError for: 'guest bootstrap is not complete', 'no ready owned rewind target', 'active guest command', 'guest control pending', 'operation not admitted in current phase', 'recovery requires last good point', 'unsupported rewind operation', 'rewind request history exhausted' (256), 'counter exhausted', 'operation queue full'.

Phase admission: pause only from ready, resume only from paused, mark from ready or paused, restore from paused or recoverable (and from recoverable only to last_good_usable); resume, restore and mark-from-ready plan generation and authority_epoch +1 each, capped at 2**53-1.

When the core reports outcome_unknown or a deadline passes (_poll: 'rewind deadline; no replay'), _failed sets the session uncertain, marks phase 'uncertain', and fails every pending future with GuestCommandUnknown; no request is resent, and only a correlated recovery_ready for a failed restore clears the uncertainty.

Point ids are derived deterministically: 'point-' + SHA-256 over length-prefixed (8-byte big-endian) session_id, workload_id and request_id; a completed mark must publish exactly that id, else 'foreign point publication'.

The point ring holds at most two points: when a mark completes with two prior points, the victim is the one with active_references 0 and lowest (created_order, point_id) ('no rotation victim' if none); restore must set active_references=1 only on the restored point and leave the ring otherwise unchanged ('restore changed immutable ring').

Inbound rewind events are rejected with RewindError for replay or capacity over 1024 event_ids ('rewind event replay/capacity'), 'foreign rewind owner', 'rewind correlation', 'stale rewind operation', 'foreign rewind workload' and 'rewind tuple changed'; a core 'refused' event fails the future with 'request refused: <code>'.
Synchronous helpers pause/resume/mark/restore call start(...).result(); calling them on the guest IO pump thread raises RewindError('IO owner cannot queue a synchronous wait') to avoid self-deadlock.

guest_command.py runs sequential guest shell jobs over one exclusively claimed authenticated ToolClient channel: no host shell, reconnection, resend or second receiver; an unknown outcome keeps ownership and only the core's correlated stopped/native_absent event confirms release.

ToolClient.guest_commands claims the entered agent channel with observe_owned=True (never creating a native guest), or raises ClientError('busy', ...) if another IO owner holds it; the claim itself raises GuestCommandError('exclusive authenticated ToolClient required') unless the client is ready, unclaimed and has no frame subscriptions, and 'registered agent identity required' unless the local component is 'agent', then starts the daemon pump thread 'mv-guest-command'.

Command inputs are bounded before submission: command is 1..16384 UTF-8 bytes without NUL; cwd is at most 1024 bytes, no control characters, relative with no empty/'.'/'..' segments ('cwd must stay below the guest workspace'); stdin at most 49152 bytes and command+stdin at most 65536; timeout_ms must be an int in 1..60000.

The guest identity tuple is fixed: every incoming session must have profile_id 'guest-command-arm64-v1', backend 'firecracker' and isa 'aarch64' and the claiming owner_id, else 'foreign guest identity'; a changed tuple is 'guest tuple changed'. This is an ARM64 MicroVM-only path.

Each inbound envelope is validated, must come from the core endpoint to the local endpoint in the same session, must have a strictly increasing seq ('replayed core sequence'), and guest events are de-duplicated by event_id with a capacity of 8192 ('event replay or capacity'); any other body family is 'unexpected body on exclusive guest channel'.

outcome_unknown from the core, an expired operation deadline ('operation deadline expired; no replay') or any pump exception ('exclusive channel failed; no replay') calls _fail: the session becomes uncertain and every pending operation's future raises GuestCommandUnknown; previously completed results are kept and nothing is resent.

Output conservation: each output chunk must be canonical base64 of 1..16384 bytes with the next chunk_index per stream and a running total at most 65536; job_finished must report stdout/stderr byte counts and SHA-256 equal to the bytes received, else 'invalid output bytes/index' or 'output conservation failed'.

Closure is proved only by a 'stopped' event for a stop operation with phase 'stopped', ownership 'released' and native_absent true; otherwise GuestCommandError('unproved guest closure'). close() alone fails pending work with 'local channel closed; guest closure unproved'.

The pump thread is the single IO owner: per loop it issues up to 8 queued ops (queue maxsize 8), sends a surface_request/v0.2 list heartbeat after 10 s idle, handles up to 32 inbound envelopes under the RLock, enforces the 5 s bootstrap deadline ('bootstrap deadline expired; no retry') and operation deadlines. In observe-owned mode it opens by sending a bootstrap mv_tool_call/v0.2 list (limit 1); until its exactly correlated ok result arrives, create/start/stop raise 'guest bootstrap is not complete'.

start() refuses with 'guest is not ready for another command' (closed, uncertain, halted, no session, phase not ready, a run active, or rewind not allowing commands) and 'job attempt limit reached' after 64 jobs; cancel needs an accepted active command and one unconsumed control; _submit refuses at 256 operations ('session request history exhausted') or a full queue.

perception/__init__.py exports 11 names (PerceptionAdapter, PerceptionError, Frame, FakePerceptionAdapter, frame_dims, check_vision, the three registry functions, VCorePerceptionAdapter, MetaMusePerceptionAdapter) and resolves them lazily through a module __getattr__ so importing the package stays inert.
Accessing VCorePerceptionAdapter or MetaMusePerceptionAdapter on the package imports .vcore or .meta_muse only at that moment; base names import .base.
Any other attribute raises AttributeError "module 'metaviewer_agents.perception' has no attribute %r"; a typo in an adapter name surfaces here, not as a PerceptionError.
No production module calls create_perception_adapter; the registry path is exercised by agents/tests/test_vcore.py (create_perception_adapter("fake") and ("vcore", ...)).

base.py defines the provider-agnostic perception contract: adapters populate only the closed vision sub-object from a bound frame_ref; admission, freshness and witnesses stay with the core; providers are chosen by an explicit registry that never falls back silently.
PerceptionError(code, message) is a ValueError with .code; documented codes are unknown_version, bad_shape, unavailable and timeout, and messages must never carry credential material.

Frame is an in-memory RGB24 row-major buffer: width/height must be exact int (type() check, so bool is refused), positive, and len(data) must equal width*height*3, else bad_shape "Frame data length %d != %d".

check_vision enforces v0.2 wire caps (summary <= 4096 chars, changed_regions and elements <= 4096 entries, element name <= 65536) before delegating to observe._check_vision, re-raising its ObservationError as PerceptionError with the same code.

The registry binds 'fake' (FakePerceptionAdapter), 'vcore' and 'meta_muse'; a missing module in a factory maps ImportError to unavailable "perception provider 'vcore' is not installed" (or 'meta_muse').

create_perception_adapter refuses unknown names with unavailable "unknown perception provider %r" and lets factory errors propagate unchanged; register_perception_adapter lets the last registration win (for test substitution) and refuses empty names or non-callables with bad_shape.
FakePerceptionAdapter is the deterministic stdlib-only adapter: it checks frame/prev against frame_ref dims and returns summary "fake perception: no change" with empty changed_regions and elements.

compiled.py admits source-free sidecar executables pinned by a public distribution lock (compiled.lock.json); an explicit executable overrides checkout mode and every regular file must be pinned, refusing missing, extra, source or linked files before spawning.

Executables are selected by MV_WENDER_EXECUTABLE (wender-agent, file wender-runtime) or MV_VISION_EXECUTABLE (vision-engine, file vision-runtime); without the variable, a root argument is probed for <root>/wender-runtime or <root>/vision-runtime; otherwise compiled_executable returns None (checkout mode).

A compiled executable must be absolute, canonical, symlink-free on every parent, an executable regular file, in the same directory as any given root (else commit_mismatch), on Linux x86_64, with lock commit equal to deps.lock (else commit_mismatch) and name equal to the lock's executable.

Every file under the executable directory must be a regular file listed in the lock (dirty_tree "unpinned compiled file"), with matching sha256 (hash_mismatch "compiled hash mismatch"); missing pinned files and all other OS/Value errors are re-raised as DependencyLockError unavailable prefixed with the environment variable name.

compiled_browser_entry accepts mode 'state' (keys element_table, tree) or 'stopstate' (keys state, url, frame_urls, headers), serializes canonical JSON capped at 1 MiB, and runs the executable with env PATH=os.defpath plus LANG only, via wender_bridge._run_bounded.

compiled_browser_entry error codes: timeout "compiled browser entry timed out", unavailable "compiled browser entry unavailable" (OSError), subprocess_failed "compiled browser entry refused" (nonzero exit), bad_shape for duplicate keys, non-finite numbers or non-object responses; it returns None when no compiled executable is selected.

Callers of compiled_executable: deps_lock.resolve_locked_component (compiled takes precedence and its parent is returned as the root), VCorePerceptionAdapter.__init__, WenderSubprocessAdapter.__init__ and wender_bridge.has_configured_wender_root; compiled_browser_entry is called by wender_bridge.detect_stopstate.

compiled.lock.json (schema metaviewer.compiled-lock/v1, platform linux-x64) pins two components, vision-engine and wender-agent, each with archive_sha256, a 40-hex commit, an executable name and a files map of per-file sha256 digests (64 files for vision-engine, 43 for wender-agent [MEASURED]).

The lock commit for each component must equal the commit in the repository deps.lock, checked by compiled_executable via deps_lock._locked_commit; a mismatch refuses with commit_mismatch "compiled lock differs from deps.lock".

archive_sha256 is not read at runtime by compiled.py; tools/build_release_assets.py reads compiled.lock.json, requires arch x64, the deps.lock commit, and that <component>-linux-<arch>.tar.gz hashes to archive_sha256 (AssetBuildError "compiled archive missing or hash mismatch").

agents/tests/test_compiled_runtime.py writes a synthetic compiled.lock.json and patches compiled.LOCK to it, covering hash mutants of binaries and shared libraries, missing library, unpinned source, symlinks, source commit mismatch, and no silent fallback to a checkout.

deps_lock.py proves private dependency provenance without importing them: resolve_locked_component returns the canonical checkout or site-packages root; Git checkouts reject untracked/ignored executable or Python files; wheel roots verify RECORD digests, admitting only PEP 610 Git provenance.

Roots come from VQA_VE_ROOT (vision-engine) and MV_WENDER_ROOT (wender-agent); the default lock is the repository-root deps.lock. An unset or blank variable refuses with unavailable "<VAR> is required".

_locked_commit requires deps.lock components to be a list of unique names with full 40-hex SHAs including both vision-engine and wender-agent; any defect or duplicate JSON key becomes bad_lockfile "invalid dependency lock".

_git runs git with a minimal env (HOME=os.devnull, LANG=C, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, core.fsmonitor=false), stdin closed and a 2.0 s timeout; any launch failure or nonzero exit is unavailable "cannot inspect dependency checkout".

For a Git checkout: HEAD != lock commit -> commit_mismatch "<name> at <actual>, expected <expected>"; assume-unchanged or skip-worktree index flags -> dirty_tree "has suppressed index entries"; tracked modifications -> dirty_tree "has tracked modifications".

_verify_tree re-hashes every tracked blob from disk (git blob SHA-1 of the bytes, mode 100644/100755/120000 must match) rather than trusting index stat hints, then walks the tree and refuses untracked payload files (executable bits, .py/.so/.pth/.sh and similar suffixes, startup hooks) with dirty_tree.

For a wheel root: exactly one <dist>-*.dist-info with direct_url.json vcs_info git and a 40-hex commit_id is required (else unavailable "cannot verify wheel provenance"); RECORD digest/size mismatch, unrecorded files, startup hooks or unverified bytecode fail as dirty_tree "<name> differs from pinned wheel tree".
DependencyLockError subclasses both ObservationError and RuntimeError so callers catching ObservationError see its code (unavailable, commit_mismatch, dirty_tree, bad_lockfile, hash_mismatch).

resolve_locked_component is called by verify.run_loop (wender-agent before spawning the planner), WenderSubprocessAdapter.__init__, planner.invoke_planner_cmd, vcore._resolve_ve_root (verify_lock=True) and mw_owner.

meta_muse.py fronts the Muse Spark model as a perception backend through an injected in-process transport callable (no external endpoint is hardcoded because the wire protocol is absent from the API packs); the adapter owns wire bounds, strict output validation and credential hygiene.

Wire tags are owned by this unit: request schema muse.vision.request/v1 with exact keys {schema, frame_ref, frame, prev}; response schema muse.vision/v1 with exact keys {schema, vision}; default response line bound 16384 bytes.

Credential hygiene: the credential must be nonempty bytes/bytearray, lives in memory only, __repr__/__str__ print only credential_set=<bool>, clear_credential drops it, and transport exceptions are reduced to unavailable "muse transport failed: <ExceptionTypeName>".

frame/prev must be a Frame with matching dims, a /proc/self/fd/<N> path, or a canonical non-symlink path under /dev/shm; anything else refuses bad_shape "<name> is not a bound frame or RAM path". frame_ref schemas other than frame_ref/v0.1 or v0.2 give unknown_version (if 'frame_ref/v'-prefixed) or bad_shape.

Before calling the transport, perceive requires a credential (unavailable "muse credential not configured"), reads the pixels (Frame, dup'd fd via pread sized exactly w*h*3, or raw RGB24 via vcore._ramws_frame) and refuses identity_mismatch "pixels disagree with frame_ref" unless sha256(pixels) equals frame_ref.sha256.

Response checks, all bad_shape unless noted: not bytes, longer than max_line ("exceeds line bound"), not UTF-8, not strict JSON (NaN/Infinity and duplicate keys rejected), keys not exactly {schema, vision}; a different non-empty schema is unknown_version "unknown muse response version"; vision goes through base.check_vision.

The request passes the caller's original frame and prev arguments (Frame object, path string or None) plus a deep copy of frame_ref to the transport; the returned vision is wrapped in vcore._BoundVision bound to frame_ref.sha256.

Tests: agents/tests/test_meta_muse.py (23 test functions [MEASURED]), test_ws3_muse_fd.py (descriptor shape refusals with real RAM files and a nonblocking FIFO), test_ws3_muse_identity.py (mismatched frame and RAM path refused before transport).

vcore.py drives the separate vision-engine program only through its CLI over an explicit checkout (never importing it): live ticks prefer the persistent vadapt.vserve JSON-lines server with raw RGB24 frames in /dev/shm, falling back to one-shot vadapt.cu_describe with memfd descriptors (/proc/self/fd/N).

Child processes get a scrubbed env: PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, HOME=/nonexistent, LANG=C.UTF-8, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, PYTHONSAFEPATH=1, PYTHONPATH=ve_root[:extra_site]; a sitecustomize/usercustomize/.pth file at the checkout root refuses dirty_tree.

_resolve_ve_root: missing root -> unavailable "ve_root or VQA_VE_ROOT is required"; not a directory -> unavailable; with verify_lock, DependencyLockError codes are re-raised as PerceptionError and a different locked root -> commit_mismatch "verified checkout differs from ve_root".

_BoundedRequestQueue (capacity 1..4, default 2) uses an abort policy: a request beyond capacity fails immediately with BUDGET_EXCEEDED "vserve request queue capacity (%d) exhausted (policy=abort)" rather than waiting; pipe I/O is serialized under an RLock.

_vserve_roundtrip: control lines over 65536 bytes -> BUDGET_EXCEEDED; leftover bytes before a request or pipelined bytes after the reply newline -> bad_shape flagged _vserve_desync and the process is closed; deadline expiry closes the process and raises timeout "vserve request timed out".

Restart budget: max_restarts (0..4, default 1) caps respawns; once exceeded _vserve_start refuses unavailable "vserve restart budget exhausted"; _perceive_vserve retries once after restart only for unavailable or desync errors.

_vserve_close_proc shuts the server down by closing stdin then waiting 0.1 s, SIGTERM then 0.2 s, SIGKILL then 0.2 s (then an unbounded wait), and always reaps; an atexit hook holding a weakref closes the adapter at interpreter exit.

perceive falls back to one-shot C2 on vserve errors unless the code is identity_mismatch or fallback_oneshot=False; in the fallback, exit 4/5/6 map to STALE_FRAME/unavailable/BUDGET_EXCEEDED only when vserve had already failed; exit 2 is bad_shape "C2 subprocess refused", others bad_shape "C2 subprocess exited with code %d"; stderr detail is capped at 1000 chars.

_vision_from_c2 maps marks to elements (role=mark kind, name=ocr_text or "mark-<id>", confidence=score); with no marks, crops become elements with role "crop", name=reason and confidence 0.5; project_element_table emits vqa.element-table/v1 with score_ppm=round(confidence*1e6) and refuses identity_mismatch if vision lacks a matching _BoundVision binding.

run_vcore accepts only verbs selftest, analyze, pack, cite-check, verify-citations, rejudge (offline QA); it maps exit 2/3 to bad_shape, 4 to STALE_FRAME, 5 to unavailable, 6 to BUDGET_EXCEEDED, refuses compiled runtimes with unavailable, and rejects schemas outside VQA_SCHEMAS as unknown_version.

vision.py is a strict perception boundary whose descriptions are evidence, never verdicts; a supervised transport returns (exit_code, stdout) and the module never guesses executable paths or launches children itself.

parse_description requires schema ve.cu_describe/v1 with a 64-hex frame_sha256, closed keys (required schema, frame_sha256, width, height, changed, changed_regions, crops, timing_us; optional marks, marks_png, crop_dir, crop_pngs), caps of 16 regions, 8 crops, 24 marks, descending scores, 1 MiB stdout cap; mark_cap_reached is true at exactly 24 marks.

Every internal check in parse_description raises a ValueError subclass that the outer handler converts to VisionBridgeError('invalid description'); the specific reason (e.g. 'scores not descending', 'symlink in RAM path') is only visible on __cause__.

RAM paths (marks_png, crop_dir, crop_pngs) must be absolute, spelled canonically with no '..', under /dev/shm/vqa-cu, and resolve to themselves (no symlink component); marks_png must accompany marks and crop_pngs must match crops in length.
describe refuses 'description refused' when the transport reply is not a (int, str) pair or rc != 0, and 'frame binding mismatch' when (frame_sha256, width, height) differ from the input frame.

describe_observation emits observation/v0.2 with an empty summary and empty elements, copying only x/y/w/h of changed regions, and validates it with observe.validate_observation (integer-only geometry, no invented element state).
No module under agents/metaviewer_agents imports vision.py [MEASURED by grep]; it is exercised by agents/tests/test_vision_ram_path.py, test_tg_vision.py, test_ailoop.py and test_fx2_agents_a.py.

planner.py is the MetaViewer-side Holdings and element-table planner and pipe CLI (Wender keeps no planner CLI by decision); plan(observation) emits action_proposal/v0.2 for Holdings, plan(observation, element_table, goal) emits a left-click plan, and the module also serves as an MV_WENDER_PLANNER_CMD target.

PlannerError codes map to CLI exit statuses: bad_shape 1, empty_goal 2, frame_mismatch 3, out_of_bounds 4, no_target 5, generation_control 6, alignment 7, policy 8, commit_mismatch 9, dirty_tree 10, bad_lockfile 11, unavailable 12; unknown codes exit 1.

Elements whose name matches ^\s*(Stop|Detener)\b (case-insensitive) are generation controls: they are marked non-actionable in the wender.state/v1 witness and never selected; if only such elements exist, the planner refuses generation_control.

Target selection: exact goal match on name or role, else substring match, else all non-stop candidates; the highest score_ppm wins with ties to the earliest index; the click is at the bbox midpoint (bx + bw // 2, by + bh // 2).

The expectation is state_sha256_change bound to ground_truth.state_sha256 with window [tick+1, tick+tick_window] (default 5) when ground_truth exists, else changed_region with the target bbox; plan() rechecks its own response through recheck_plan before returning.

recheck_plan refuses lane_submit with policy "lane_submit is forbidden", non-left-click actions, viewport mismatch (frame_mismatch), click outside target box (alignment), and recomputes the deterministic wender.state/v1 witness: any difference is bad_shape "state witness disagrees with element_table".

Holdings planning requires ground_truth.source == "holdings_lane"; actions must be click/key/type/scroll (else policy); with no action and no vision it clicks the frame centre; plan_holdings bounds proposal_id 1..128 chars, max_ms 1..3600000, max_retries 0..10.

CLI main (python3 -m metaviewer_agents.planner) takes no arguments, reads at most 1 MiB of strict JSON on stdin in three shapes ({observation, element_table, goal}, a bare observation, or an observation wrapper), writes canonical JSON on stdout and prints "<code>: <detail>" on stderr with the mapped exit code.

invoke_planner_cmd wraps any exception from _run_bounded (including subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as bad_shape "external planner execution failed: {exc}", so a timed-out external planner is reported as bad_shape, not timeout; the child env is only PYTHONPATH and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
loop_trials imports plan_holdings_step as the default trial planner; tests/e2e/e1_slice/holdings_live_trials.py also imports it.

loop_trials.py runs the single-shot observe -> propose -> admit -> act -> verify loop across independent trials (default 10, pass at 9 verified) without retrying a refused proposal inside a trial, and emits a metaviewer.ai-loop-report/v1 receipt with keys {schema, trials, verified, pass, results}.
Trial kinds alternate: odd trial numbers are holdings, even are browser, unless kind is forced; each trial gets proposal_id "trial-<n>" and calls verify.run_loop.

Per-trial exception mapping: ToolRefusal -> status refused with its reason_code; VerificationFailed -> timeout/TIMEOUT or unverified with the receipt code or VERIFICATION_FAILED; TimeoutError -> TIMEOUT; ObservationError/SurfaceError -> refused with code or OBSERVATION_ERROR; ToolValidationError/ValueError -> unverified with UNVERIFIED_RECEIPT or VALIDATION_ERROR.

A trial counts as verified only if the receipt has verified=True, method in pixel/element/state_sha256 and a non-empty detail; holdings (or state_sha256_change) trials also need ground_truth.source holdings_lane, method state_sha256 and after_frame.tick inside [min_tick, max_tick]; otherwise code MISSING_WITNESS.

validate_report recounts rows: reported verified != counted -> tampered_verified; reported pass != recomputed ratio -> tampered_pass; inconsistent row status/code/witness, wrong kind order or key sets -> bad_shape.
Bounds: trials 1..1000, min_verified 1..trials, timeout_ms 1..60000 (run_trials default 60000, CLI default 1000); compute_ratio is integer-only.

CLI main: --verify-receipt validates an existing receipt; otherwise, with no injected client_factory/planner, it runs scripted test doubles (make_holdings_double or make_scripted_double) rather than a live session; exit 0 when pass is true, 1 when false, 2 on errors.

agents/tests/test_loop_trials.py covers 10/10 and 9/10 passing with alternating kinds, no retry of refused proposals, an 8/10 negative control with pass false and nonzero exit, and tampered receipts failing revalidation.

wender_bridge.py is the MetaViewer side of a pipe-only subprocess boundary to the separate wender-agent program: it sends {observation, element_table, goal} as UTF-8 JSON and accepts {action, expectation, state, target_node}; it admits only click plans and does not dispatch or confer admission.

Planner argv precedence: explicit command, then MV_WENDER_PLANNER_CMD (must be a non-empty JSON argv list, else bad_shape "planner command must be JSON argv"), then DEFAULT_WENDER_PLANNER_CMD (sys.executable -m wender.plan.cli); with a compiled runtime the default becomes (<executable>, 'plan').

_run_bounded feeds stdin in 4096-byte writes while draining stdout (cap 1 MiB) and stderr (cap 64 KiB) under one deadline; exceeding a cap raises bad_shape "planner output exceeds maximum size"; stderr is discarded (b"") and the child is killed and reaped in finally.

plan_step errors: timeout "Wender planner timed out", unavailable "Wender planner launch failed", subprocess_failed "Wender planner exited unsuccessfully", bad_shape "Wender response is not unique UTF-8 JSON" or "planner response keys invalid", and SurfaceError("alignment", "click") when the click falls outside target_node.box.

The planner child env holds only PATH and LANG from the parent plus PYTHONPATH=wender_root and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; battery_state_sha256 is cleared at the start of each plan_step and set only after all response and custody checks pass.

WenderSubprocessAdapter.__init__ needs MV_WENDER_ROOT, wender_root or a compiled runtime (unavailable "MV_WENDER_ROOT or wender_root required"); verify_lock defaults to True when wender_root or command is omitted, and a locked root different from wender_root is commit_mismatch.

WenderModelBackend accepts providers muse_cli, muse_spark or baseten; credentials only as non-empty NUL-free bytes/bytearray (strings and paths refused with bad_shape); repr and redact() print "<redacted>"; baseten without a credential or a missing transport refuses unavailable in invoke().

WenderSubprocessAdapter stores self.model_backend = coerce_model_backend(model_backend), but plan_step never references it: the planner subprocess request contains only observation, element_table and goal.

detect_stopstate uses the compiled 'stopstate' entry when selected and validates its receipt keys {is_stop, reason, confidence, evidence} (bad_shape "compiled detector receipt invalid"); with no compiled runtime it imports wender.perceive.stopstate.detect in-process, so a missing package raises ImportError.

verify.run_loop builds WenderSubprocessAdapter with the resolved locked root and projects observation.vision via vcore.project_element_table before plan_step; it refuses unavailable "Wender requires perception evidence" when the observation has no vision.

export.py builds and validates the closed mw.run_bundle.v1 export bundle from a verified session journal (metaviewer.journal/v1 header plus hash-chained session_record/v0.2 lines), verified receipts, observations, proposals, verdicts and wender.state/v1 objects, stripping paths, cookies, credentials and account text and failing closed.
Constants: BUNDLE_SCHEMA mw.run_bundle.v1, JOURNAL_HEADER_SCHEMA metaviewer.journal/v1, SESSION_RECORD_SCHEMA session_record/v0.2, MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES 262144; exceeding the size refuses bundle_oversize.

verify_journal refuses corrupt_journal (empty text, blank line, inexact keys, bad kind, gap in core_seq), duplicate_record (non-increasing core_seq or repeated msg_id) and chain_mismatch (prev_sha256 not equal to the canonical sha256 of the previous clean record).

_scan_forbidden_bundle walks the whole bundle for pixel keys, Frame/bytes values, >=256-int arrays in 0..255, data: image strings, host paths, cookies, credentials and PII; validate_export_bundle maps the alphabetically lowest finding code to forbidden_pixels, forbidden_host_path, forbidden_cookie, forbidden_credential or forbidden_personal_data.

Receipts must be action_receipt/v0.2 (else unknown_version) with verified=True (else unverified_receipt); an admitted step without a verified receipt is unverified_receipt; a verdict whose decision disagrees with the journal record at core_seq, or mismatched proposal_ids, refuse uncorrelated.

validate_export_bundle maps schema errors containing 'unexpected properties' to unknown_field (others bad_shape) and then applies semantic_error checks: valid hostnames, steps seq 1..n, paste kind iff text_len, positive-area boxes, recorded points inside viewport, unique ids across vision_elements/state_refs/refusals, refusal step_seq <= steps.

build_export_bundle and validate_export_bundle have no callers outside export.py in agents/ [MEASURED by grep]; they are exercised by agents/tests/test_export.py (9 tests [MEASURED]) including journal tampering, unverified receipts and forbidden-content controls.

tools/gate.sh accepts no argument (selector 'skeleton' = all legs), '--self-test', or '--leg <name>' with one of skeleton|laws|contracts|unit|agents|manifests|js|rust|go|ui|ui-smoke|perf; anything else prints usage and exits 2. Missing python3 prints 'BLOCKED <selector>: missing python3' and 'BLOCKED aggregate'.

The skeleton selector runs the legs in the fixed order of LEAVES: manifests, laws, contracts, unit, agents, js, rust, go, ui, ui-smoke, perf (11 legs); the bash wrapper execs an embedded Python heredoc.

Leg exit statuses map to PASS (0), BLOCKED (2) or FAIL (other); each leg prints '<STATUS> <leg>' and the aggregate rc is 124 if any leg timed out, else 2 if any BLOCKED, else 1 if any FAIL, else 0, and prints 'PASS aggregate' or 'FAIL aggregate'. Missing bash/python3/timeout/mktemp prints 'BLOCKED <selector>: missing <runner>'.

Before running a leg, gate.sh requires its target files: e.g. laws needs VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, tools/check_laws.py; contracts needs tools/check_contracts.py and contracts/; perf needs tools/budget_gate.py and tests/perf files. An absent target prints 'missing target: <name>' and returns 2 (BLOCKED).

The laws leg runs 'python3 tools/check_laws.py --version' then runs check_laws.py through LAWS_CODE, which patches subprocess so 'git rev-list --all' becomes 'git rev-list --exclude=refs/stash --all' (stash commits are not checked). The contracts leg runs 'python3 tools/check_contracts.py'. Both share a 300 s deadline.

The unit leg discovers tests/ and tests/e2e/e2e1_slice; an empty selection prints 'empty test selection; refusing silent pass' and exits 2, and any skipped, expected-failure or unexpected-success test makes the leg fail (no silent skips).

The agents leg requires agents/tests and agents/tests/run_mutant_harness.py ('missing target: agents/tests' / 'missing target: agents/tests/run_mutant_harness.py', rc 1), then runs the agents unittest suite and the mutant harness within 300 s.

The js leg needs MV_KIT_CHECKOUT or CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO pointing at the pinned capsule-ui-kit checkout; otherwise it prints 'kit absent: set MV_KIT_CHECKOUT (or CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO) ...' and fails with rc 1. It runs node tools/sync_kit.mjs and then with --check.

The rust leg requires rustup with pinned toolchain 1.92.0 for 'cargo fmt --all --check', plus clippy ('-D warnings') and 'cargo test --locked --offline'; the ui leg requires Node >=24 ('ui: Node >=24 required'), runs 'npm ci --offline', node --test over ui/test/*.test.js, then vue-tsc --noEmit and vite build. Missing tools return 2 ('<leg>: missing tool: <name>').

The go leg runs in daemon-adapter with GOPROXY=off, GOSUMDB=off, GOTOOLCHAIN=local: go vet and 'go test -race -count=1' for the host arch, then vet and a compile-only test (-exec /bin/true) for the other of amd64/arm64. Missing go prints 'go: missing tool: go' and returns 1 (FAIL, not BLOCKED).

The ui-smoke leg needs an executable local Electron (ELECTRON_OVERRIDE_DIST_PATH or ui/node_modules/electron) and xvfb-run, else BLOCKED (rc 2) with 'ui-smoke: no executable local Electron; ...' or 'ui-smoke: no display harness: missing xvfb-run'. It runs ui/test/smoke.mjs and smoke-main.mjs and requires the exact markers METAVIEWER_SMOKE_OK and METAVIEWER_MAIN_SMOKE_OK; a zero exit without the marker fails.

The perf leg always runs test_budget_gate*.py, 'budget_gate.py --self-test', tests/perf/proc_fields.test.mjs, and a negative control 'budget_gate.py --receipt tests/perf/leak-renderer.json' that must exit 1. The live Electron RSS probe runs only with MV_GATE_PERF_LIVE=1 and otherwise prints 'perf: live probe SKIPPED (MV_GATE_PERF_LIVE not set)' and passes.

Every child command runs through bounded(): a new session, a per-run MV_SUBREAPER_TOKEN in its environment, PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER (prctl 36), a default 300 s wait, 'timeout: <argv>' with rc 124 on expiry, and stop_process_tree() in finally.

The manifests leg checks deps.lock against fixed COMPONENT_PINS (vision-engine v0.2.0, wender-agent v0.3.0, opensuperficies os-cu-w9-mv1, each with a 40-hex commit); drift raises 'deps.lock: <name>: release pin drift', and frozen resolution runs 'cargo metadata --offline --locked' and 'npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --dry-run' in a disposable temp tree.

CI does not call tools/gate.sh; README documents 'bash tools/gate.sh', '--leg contracts' and '--self-test' as the 11-leg offline gate, and tools/budget_gate.py reuses the gate's descendants/process_identity/stop_process_tree/bounded functions by parsing the heredoc.

tools/check_laws.py checks commit identity, commit messages, VERSION/CHANGELOG agreement and changelog fragments with the standard library only. Modes: --range REV_RANGE, --message-file PATH, --version, hidden --check-ident; no flag checks all history.

Commit subjects must match '<scope>: <Verb> ...' with scope in core|contracts|ui|ci|docs|deps|tools, be at most 72 characters, and start with one of the fixed VERBS set (add, allow, apply, audit, bump, change, check, clean, configure, create, define, document, enforce, fix, implement, improve, initialize, keep, move, pin, prepare, prevent, refactor, release, remove, rename, replace, require, restore, revert, run, seal, set, simplify, support, test, update, use, validate, wire).

Message refusals: 'forbidden message pattern: <word>' for any FORBIDDEN substring anywhere in the message (attribution trailers such as co-authored-by and generated with, assistant and AI vendor or model names, and ai-generated; the list is tools/check_laws.py FORBIDDEN), 'subject exceeds 72 characters', 'subject must use an allowed scope followed by ": " and an English imperative', 'subject must start with a supported English imperative verb (see VERBS)'.

Author and committer must both equal the single maintainer NAME/EMAIL pair; otherwise '<role> must be <NAME> <<EMAIL>>' is reported per role. --check-ident failure prints 'identity must be oguirado <EMAIL>'.

A commit touching product code (any path not under docs/, changes/, catalogue/, router/index/, tests/, .github/, .githooks/ and not a listed top-level file) must add a fragment changes/unreleased/<slug>.md; with ALLOW_DIRECT_CHANGELOG True (env MV_CHANGELOG_ALLOW_DIRECT can turn it off) a direct CHANGELOG.md edit also satisfies it. Otherwise: 'product code change requires a changelog fragment in changes/unreleased/<slug>.md (or CHANGELOG.md during transition)'.

Fragment refusals: '<name>: fragment file name must match lowercase [a-z0-9-]+.md', 'fragment is not valid UTF-8', 'fragment is empty', '<name>:<line>: line must be a "- " bullet entry', 'line exceeds maximum length of 1000 characters', forbidden patterns per line, and 'fragment contains no "- " bullet lines'; path refusal 'fragment path must match changes/unreleased/<slug>.md with lowercase [a-z0-9-]'.

Fragment enforcement in history only applies to commits after CHANGELOG_ENFORCEMENT_BASE (8c08e60f...) that contain changes/README.md; --version mode requires VERSION to be SemVer ('VERSION must be valid semantic versioning') and a matching '## <version>' heading ('CHANGELOG.md lacks a matching ## <version> section').
Every error is printed to stderr as 'ERROR: <error>' and the exit code is 1; success prints 'Laws check: OK'. Git/OS/Unicode failures become 'cannot complete laws check: <exc>'.
CI runs check_laws.py with --range "$RANGE" (or no range) as gate laws-range and with --version as gate laws-version; gate.sh runs it in its laws leg.
tools/check_contracts.py is a fail-closed validator for a documented JSON Schema subset (draft 2020-12 keywords listed in KEYWORDS), covering contract versions v0.1 and v0.2.

Schema audit rules: every object schema must set additionalProperties false ('every object schema must set additionalProperties false'), a 'schema' property must be required with a versioned const, only '#/$defs' references to sibling schemas resolve, and unsupported keywords refuse ('bad schema or unsupported keyword').

Each contracts/<version>/*.schema.json must have $id 'https://metaviewer.local/contracts/<version>/<file>', the draft URI and a title, plus at least one <name>.valid*.json and one <name>.invalid.*.json example; valid examples must pass and invalid ones must fail ('expected pass' / 'expected failure'); unrelated example files refuse as 'unrecognized or unchecked example'.

For v0.2, positive fixtures must witness every reachable enum member and oneOf branch ('unwitnessed alternative <path>'), and mv_tool_result.schema.json $defs.frame must equal the canonical frame_ref.schema.json ('$defs.frame drifted from canonical ...').
Strict JSON loading rejects duplicate keys ('duplicate JSON key: <k>'), NaN/Infinity ('invalid JSON constant'), nonfinite numbers, lone surrogates and nesting over 100.

Errors print 'ERROR: <version>: <path>: <reason>' to stderr and exit 1; success prints 'Contracts check: OK (schemas audited; valid examples accepted; invalid examples rejected)'. CI runs it as gate 'contracts'; gate.sh runs it in the contracts leg.

tools/gate_g_ai.py is a local-only live G-AI assertion runner ('--surface mv-live-1' only) whose stdout is one canonical JSON receipt with schema 'metaviewer.g-ai-receipt/v1'; it starts BLOCKED with rc 5 and A1..A8 false, and becomes rc 0 / DONE only if all assertions, all negative controls and cleanup proof hold.

Exactly 19 named negative controls must all be True (REQUIRED_NEGATIVE_CONTROLS: dependency missing/pin for vision-engine and wender-agent, A2_path, A2_digest, A3_binding, A3_float, A4_float_validate, A4_float_digest, A5_stop, A5_box, A5_custody, A6_binding, A6_stale, A7_focus, A7_timestamp, A8_window, A8_no_change); otherwise 'incomplete negative controls'.

GateFailure codes are 'assertion_failed' (from require) and 'negative_control_accepted' ('mutated evidence passed its gate'); the receipt error is {code, detail}. A failed receipt write sets code 'receipt_write_failed' and BLOCKED.

The live run must show pixel change (post-frame sha256 differs: 'post-action pixels did not change'), a post tick within frame tick+1..+100, a STALE_FRAME refusal when the same proposal is resubmitted ('core admitted stale generation' otherwise), a changed post-action state, and cleanup with ram_absent true ('cleanup proof missing').

Preflight resolves the locked vision-engine and wender-agent components (separate proprietary programs pinned in deps.lock) via VQA_VE_ROOT and MV_WENDER_ROOT, refuses if their packages were imported into the host process ('private package imported into host'), and records deps_verified commits. MV_WENDER_PLANNER_CMD optionally selects a configured planner instead of the local planner.

No CI job runs gate_g_ai.py; docs/TESTING.md lists 'python3 tools/gate_g_ai.py --surface mv-live-1' as a live gate needing a real running capsule, and tools/mw_run_backend.py loads it as module 'mv_entry_glue'.

tools/budget_gate.py is the standalone AC-14 RSS gate with modes --self-test (offline matrix), --receipt PATH, or --probe --electron PATH. Caps [CITED AC-14]: rss_main_bytes 200000000, rss_renderer_bytes 370000000, rss_tree_bytes 1150000000; workload ready, resize, reload, terminal-toggle, shutdown.

evaluate() requires receipt schema 'metaviewer.perf.rss-receipt/v1', the exact workload list, orphans == [], duration >= gateDurationMs, at least 6 samples with strictly increasing at_ms, tree RSS >= main+renderer+utility, the opening sample within sampleMs, no gap over 2*sampleMs; failing shape checks report messages such as 'receipt schema', 'orphan evidence', 'empty/short cohort', 'sample gap'.

Output is one JSON summary {passed, failed, skipped, source 'G-PERF', ...}; exit 1 when failed, 2 with an 'error' field on ValueError/OSError/TypeError. Self-test also counts constant instruments (always_under_budget/always_over_budget) and fails if either has zero mismatches. GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY receives a JSON block when set.

Callers: gate.sh perf leg (self-test plus leak-renderer negative control, live probe under xvfb-run when MV_GATE_PERF_LIVE=1) and CI, which runs 'budget_gate.py --self-test' and imports tools.budget_gate.

tools/router_index.py compiles one ctx.node.v2 record per git-tracked source file into catalogue/nodes.jsonl (and catalogue/routes.tsv); --check rebuilds in memory and fails on stale artifacts, unrouted tracked files, dangling doc links, mount/SHA disagreement, or a kit builder that cannot run. Sources come only from 'git ls-files', minus a fixed generated set.

All failures are RouterError strings printed to stderr with exit 1, e.g. 'Router error: symlink refused <rel>', 'Router error: node id collision for <rel>', 'Router error: id width overflow for <rel>', 'Router error: missing kit input <rel>', 'Router error: kit builder timeout', 'Stale or incomplete router: <path>'; an unknown option gives 'Router error: unknown option ...' and exit 2. Success prints 'METAVIEWER_ROUTER_COVERAGE 100% <n> files'.
Router-unavailable detection: if llms.txt contains 'Status: router unavailable.', --check admits uncalibrated params (allow_uncalibrated_params) in the corpus-agreement check.
CI gate 'router-check' runs 'timeout 1200 python3 tools/router_index.py --check' and reports BLOCKED if the file is absent; AGENTS.md names the same command as the verify step.

tools/mw_run_program.py performs bounded visual actions on an already running agent-owned program capsule through the existing core admission pipeline; success proves verified moves only and never claims the goal or game was completed (report goal_completed is null).

The documented entry is 'PYTHONPATH=agents python3 -m metaviewer_agents.mw_run --identity PROFILE --surface-kind program --planner rules --goal ... --steps N'; tools/mw_run_program.py main() itself takes --identity, --goal (required), --text, --key (Up/Down/Left/Right/Enter), --steps (default 1), --timeout-ms (default 10000), --planner rules|muse, --model-timeout-ms (default 120000).

Request bounds: goal is a nonempty string up to 4096 chars ('MW_PROGRAM_GOAL'), steps 1..16 ('MW_PROGRAM_STEPS'), timeout_ms 1..30000 ('MW_PROGRAM_BUDGET'); text needs --steps 1 ('MW_PROGRAM_TEXT_STEPS'); --goal focused needs --text ('MW_PROGRAM_FOCUSED_TEXT_REQUIRED'); model timeout 1..240000 ('MW_PROGRAM_PLANNER'); focused-key needs one PROGRAM_KEYS key, steps 1, no text, rules planner ('MW_PROGRAM_KEY_REQUEST').

Grounding: in rules mode --goal must equal exactly one observed element name after normalization, and the planned target's name, role and box must match that element; otherwise 'MW_PROGRAM_GOAL_UNGROUNDED'. Clicks must fall inside the target box ('MW_PROGRAM_CLICK_TARGET').

Surface ownership: the identity must resolve to exactly one surface ('MW_RUN_NO_SURFACE', 'MW_RUN_AMBIGUOUS'), with control 'agent' or the run refuses 'MW_PROGRAM_CONTROL'; MV_SRF_STATE_DIR is required ('MW_RUN_CONFIG') and the identity must match the profile pattern ('MW_IDENTITY').

Evidence must live in private RAM: the base is XDG_STATE_HOME or /dev/shm/vqa-cu/metaviewer-program-<uid>, must be absolute, canonical and under /dev/shm ('MW_PROGRAM_RAM_REQUIRED'), with no symlink ancestors and owner-only mode 0700 ('MW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT'). Each run writes report.json and moves.json under metaviewer/runs/<uuid>.

Result JSON on stdout has schema 'metaviewer.mw_run/v1' with rc and verdict_code: rc 0 'PROGRAM_BOUNDED_ACTIONS_VERIFIED' (or 'PROGRAM_TEXT_UNCERTIFIED_NOT_READABLE' when OCR readback is not_readable), rc 6 refusal with the error code, rc 5 'INPUT_UNCERTAIN' when a move was delivered or an attempt is input_uncertain/dispatch_or_settlement_pending/settlement_pending.

Click effect verification uses a whole-surface changed_region expectation; when no RGB change remains outside excluded clock marks the run refuses 'MW_PROGRAM_NO_VISIBLE_EFFECT'. Known password fields refuse 'MW_PROGRAM_PASSWORD' before input, and readable OCR disagreement refuses 'MW_PROGRAM_TEXT_MISMATCH'.

With --planner muse the runner wraps the planner in MuseProgramPlanner, which starts tools/mw_program_muse.py as a separate child process (sys.executable) and refuses with MW_PROGRAM_MODEL_TIMEOUT, MW_PROGRAM_MODEL_FAILED ('invalid model JSON') or MW_PROGRAM_MODEL_TARGET; a model rejection before any proposal ends as a clean refusal rather than INPUT_UNCERTAIN.

focused-key (one navigation key) is allowed only on a Host program whose binding has host_xpra True; otherwise 'MW_PROGRAM_KEY_HOST_ONLY'. The md states it certifies delivery plus pixel effect, not gameplay.

tools/mw_run_browser_goal.py runs goal-driven browser actions on an Agent browser capsule using native AX plus the core path; steps bound admitted actions, not goal completion, and no stored workflow, planner text or score fallback authorizes input. It reuses validate_request, require_grounded_goal, private_evidence_base and MuseProgramPlanner from mw_run_program.

Text rules: text is 1..65536 UTF-8 bytes ('MW_BROWSER_TEXT'), the only key is Enter and only with text ('MW_BROWSER_KEY'), and text needs at least 2 steps, or 3 with Enter ('MW_BROWSER_STEPS'); focus targets must be textbox/combobox ('MW_BROWSER_FOCUS').

Before every input stage guard_wall() checks for a login or challenge wall through a HandoffLatch; a latched wall raises 'MW_HANDOFF_REQUIRED', which run_entry maps to rc 4 'HUMAN_HANDOFF' (a person takes over; the tool does not act on the wall).

Error mapping in run_entry: SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED becomes 'MW_PROGRAM_CONTROL'; native discovery timeout 'MW_RUN_NATIVE'; core ClientError 'MW_RUN_CORE' ('is this the running MetaViewer core?'); DependencyLockError 'MW_DEPENDENCY' (set MV_WENDER_ROOT to the deps.lock commit); pending dispatch/settlement gives rc 5 'INPUT_UNCERTAIN'. Success is rc 0 'BROWSER_BOUNDED_ACTIONS_VERIFIED'.
report.json always records goal_completed None, vision_crosscheck 'not_performed' and model_reading 'commentary_only', plus moves, attempts, frame_attempts and handoff persistence state.

Entry is metaviewer_agents.mw_run with --surface-kind browser (default) and --goal; the md documents running it from the Terminal tab inside a subshell that sources the attach current.env and sets XDG_STATE_HOME to a fresh /dev/shm directory.

tools/mw_program_muse.py is the pipe boundary for explicitly requested Muse model decisions: it reads one JSON request on stdin, and either runs the compiled wender-agent runtime as a separate process with subcommand 'model' or calls the wender-agent model client, printing {c3, model_metadata} as JSON.

Request paths (workspace, c2.marks_png, frame_png) must be canonical, under /dev/shm/vqa-cu, without symlink ancestors, owned by the user with mode 0700 (dirs) or 0600 (files), and share one parent; otherwise ValueError 'model path must be canonical RAM without symlink ancestors' / 'model path must have private ownership and mode' / 'model images and workspace must share the private RAM run'.
Any exception prints {error:{type, message[:1000]}} JSON and exits 6; a nonzero compiled runtime exit is propagated.

tools/muse_session.py runs one app (--app absolute executable) with a fresh private session root under XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (metaviewer-muse-*, mode 0700, .owner.json, memoryweb/), sets MV_MUSE_WORKSPACE, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and MV_MW_HOME for the child, forwards SIGINT/SIGTERM, and removes the root afterwards.

Refusal strings (printed to stderr, exit 2): MUSE_SESSION_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED, MUSE_SESSION_APP_REQUIRED, MUSE_SESSION_EXTERNAL_IDENTITY_STORE_REQUIRED (SRF_IDENTITY_STORE_ROOT must be an absolute canonical directory), MUSE_SESSION_RETAINED_LIVE_CHILD (child did not exit within 10 s of terminate), MUSE_SESSION_ROOT_CHANGED (root inode changed before removal).
docs/AGENT_ENTRY.md documents 'python3 tools/muse_session.py --app ...' for an ephemeral Muse session; tests/test_muse_session.py covers it.

tools/mv_demo.py provides operator demonstration custody and offline MemoryWeb validation with verbs record (--identity, --demo), prompt (--demo, --site) and check (--site); output is JSON with schema 'metaviewer.demo/v1'. When MV_SESSION_ID is set (and not MV_DEMO_HOST_CHILD=1) it forwards to a remote demo host.

Recording validation: 1..501 event rows, each line at most 4096 bytes, only the FIELDS keys, kinds click/dblclick/drag/scroll/key/text/stop, text rows carry only text_len 1..4096 (no characters; 'RECORDING_TEXT_LEAK'), keys must be in the non-printable KEYS set or a ctrl/alt/super chord, and the last row must be stop with reason operator/limit/recorder_exited ('UNSEALED_RECORDING').

Internal refusal codes (INVALID_ID, UNSAFE_PATH, UNSAFE_RECORDING, RECORDING_CAPACITY, DEMO_EXISTS, MW_HOME_REFUSED, MEMORYWEB_REPO_REQUIRED, SITE_CAPACITY, UNSAFE_SITE, MEMORYWEB_CHECK_FAILED, ...) are collapsed: the user sees only 'DEMO_REFUSED', except 'DEMO_HOST_UNAVAILABLE' and 'ACTING_STEP_LOCATE_WAIT_REQUIRED' (with hint 'Set locate_wait_ms to 5000 on every interactive step, then run check again.'); exit code 6.
