check copies an AI-written site as untrusted data without following links, bounded to SITE_FILES 8192 files, SITE_BYTES 128 MiB and SITE_DEPTH 12, and requires MV_MEMORYWEB_REPO for the read-only authoring checkout ('MEMORYWEB_REPO_REQUIRED').
The UI calls it from ui/electron/buttonBridge.js, building argv [tools/mv_demo.py, verb, ...] for record/prompt/check.

tools/arm64_capsules.py admits operator-provided ARM capsule assets and never downloads or installs them; operations doctor, configure-local (both need --descriptor) and status (reads the registry). Output schema 'metaviewer-arm64-setup-result/v1' with capabilities ['vm','microvm'] on success.

host_check requires an aarch64 host, /dev/kvm with KVM API version 12 (ioctl 0xAE00), and each capsule image present locally via 'docker image inspect' with Architecture arm64 and Os linux ('ARM64 host required', 'KVM API unavailable', 'local capsule image mismatch').

The descriptor is a closed object with schema 'metaviewer-arm64-setup/v1', a 40-hex source_commit, an ARM64 ELF app (e_machine 183) bound to resources/app.asar, and a Python 3.11+ interpreter probed with -I -B ('isolated interpreter prefix/import validation failed').

Every Refused/OSError/ValueError/SubprocessError collapses to {configured:false, error:'ARM64_SETUP_REFUSED'} and exit 2; configure-local publishes the registry by link() of an fsynced private file, refusing replacement.

tools/arm64_capsule_session.py launches one owned normal ARM capsule session from the protected local registry written by arm64_capsules.py: it re-validates the registry, binds --app/--source-root/--expected-commit to it, runs host_check and a 32 GiB MemAvailable floor, takes session.lock, and starts itself in a systemd user scope.

The scope is 'systemd-run --user --scope' unit metaviewer-arm64-<run_id>.scope in newton-ia.slice with MemoryHigh=6G, MemoryMax=8G, MemorySwapMax=0, CPUQuota=200%, TasksMax=256, running the helper with --internal-root.

A previous held-session.json refuses with 'previous session requires reconciliation'; a commit mismatch refuses 'sealed package/source mismatch'; all failures print 'ARM64_SESSION_REFUSED: <error>; retained state requires inspection' and exit 2, never guessing cleanup.
ui/tools/package.js packages arm64_capsules.py, arm64_capsule_session.py, arm64_capsule_reconcile.py and mv_identity.py and points the helper at tools/arm64_capsule_session.py.

tests/e2e/run.py is the CI E2E entry: it sets MV_E2E_LIVE=1, requires CAPSULE_UI_KIT_REPO or MV_KIT_CHECKOUT ('E2E_PREREQ: pinned kit checkout absent'), syncs the kit, builds into a temp MV_E2E_BUILD, runs 'node --test --test-concurrency=1' over every tests/e2e/*.test.js, then reruns e2e1_wall.test.js with MV_E2E_CROSS_ROUTE=1 and requires it to fail with E2E_ROUTING ('E2E_MUTANT: cross-routing must fail the live assertion' otherwise).
CI job runs run.py under 'xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x900x24"' with a 1200 s timeout, and reports BLOCKED 'xvfb-run not installed on runner' when xvfb-run is missing.

tests/e2e/harness.js owns the Electron-under-xvfb spawn, scratch profile, fake-capsule manifest and strict closed probe-report validation; prerequisites fail closed with E2E_PREREQ ('electron binary missing or not executable', 'xvfb-run not installed on PATH') instead of skipping, and it refuses to signal its own pid or process group (E2E_PID).
validateWallReport fails with E2E_ROUTING when a frame is routed to two tiles or a tile shows an unpublished or foreign frame; this is the oracle the cross-route mutant must trip.
ac02_oracle_regression loads the real ac02 journey with an injected broken cadence and proves the soak oracle must fail (negative control independent of adapter fixes); no Electron needed.

ac02_wall pins AC-02 targets (four live tiles, 10 fps floor, 10-minute soak), selects tiles by stable id, and refuses cross-routed frames; contract tests run with node alone, the live journey needs Electron and xvfb.
ac03_lifecycle pins the five contract catalog kinds and validates create/destroy/lost lifecycle traces with tombstones; live part uses Electron under xvfb.
ac04_control validates the human/agent control journey witness and selects the control tile/button by stable ids; live part uses Electron under xvfb.
ac05_ai validates one tool call per op, rejects unknown ops/extra keys/bad ids, and admits a fresh in-bounds proposal (AI observe-propose path); live part uses Electron under xvfb.
ac06_multislot validates the multislot report and refuses two slots sharing one terminal session.
ac07_ram_first pins the record_request tag/op set and accepts ram_start, ram_stop and screenshot plus disk_start with a host destination.
adapter_startup proves an adapter startup refusal or spawn error rejects the pending connection instead of leaving core listening, with a finite deadline; node only.

asm_web_hosted runs static HTML page fixtures (determinism, CSP, data: URI rules) through hosted tasks T1 form fill and T2 two-page flow; skipping wait_verify makes a task fail with UNVERIFIED_ACTION_RECEIPT.
asm_web_live_hosted proves live web stays inert without its own opt-in even when MV_E2E_LIVE is set, and that explicit opt-in fails before allocation when identity/prerequisites are absent.

asm_web_memoryweb_hosted replays MemoryWeb through the real wender-agent runner and admitted hosted RPC; it requires MV_MW_WENDER_ROOT or MV_WENDER_ROOT (locked checkout), and mutants (invalid site, unsupported drag) refuse before input.
asm_web_packs_hosted proves built-in packs reproduce T1-T3 through hosted RPC and default discovery stays exactly T1-T3, with META only when explicitly requested.
e2e10 drives the real Rust core (via core-driver.js, cargo build) and asserts a gen7->gen8 stale proposal returns StaleFrame with budget unchanged at 10000.
e2e11 proves a six-event replay equals a pinned golden digest twice with byte-identical journals, and a tampered journal refuses.
e2e12 proves golden replay is unchanged with clock/network/model access blocked and duplicates refuse; native probes for cc and strace fail with typed E2E_PREREQ when absent.
e2e13 runs the hosted slice 20 times in mode 'hosted-core-only' and asserts all 20 state digests are identical.
e2e14 measures wall canvas cadence and folded capture in a soak and proves a producer stall fails; needs Electron and xvfb.
e2e15 proves the real tileScheduler conserves accepted == presented + dropped + queued, and an undrawn frame without a canvas is released, not counted as presented.
e2e16 proves Chromium enforces product flags, CSP, popup denial and the preload allowlist (unsafe flags fail), and the slots channel rejects unknown request fields; needs Electron.
e2e17 proves real-core arrival-order determinism: different arrival orders give the same admitted proposal count.

e2e18 runs real Electron main/renderer/tree RSS measurement against frozen caps (receipt schema metaviewer.perf.rss-receipt/v1, no orphans, >= 6 samples) and proves a leak receipt fails with failures ['rss_renderer_bytes']; needs Electron and xvfb.
e2e19 proves nested depth one boots a read-only inner wall with separate profile and sockets, while depth two and a shared socket path are refused; needs Electron and the metaviewer-core binary.

e2e1_slice proves the hosted core gen7->gen8 stale refusal, pending cancellation, drain, release, dispatch, receipt and replay path, and that LIVE requires explicit authorization and real prerequisites.

e2e1_wall is the live wall journey (wall renders four tiles without cross-routing, AC-02); it pins the xvfb geometry shared with CI and refuses a missing Electron override; it is the target of run.py's cross-route mutant.
e2e20 asserts the pinned 1280x900x24 geometry in XVFB_ARGV and that a missing live prerequisite ends with typed E2E_GATE or E2E_PREREQ.
e2e21 proves the New Capsule launcher creates and destroys each offered kind and terminal ids never revive; needs Electron.
e2e22 proves the real core correlation trace requires strictly increasing sequence numbers.
e2e23 proves unknown and destroyed capsule ids give distinct refusals: UNKNOWN_REFUSAL is StaleFrame and DESTROYED_REFUSAL is SurfaceNotAgentControlled.
e2e24 proves validateWallReport accepts a matching publisher map and refuses swapped, foreign or unpublished frames with E2E_ROUTING; node only.
e2e25 proves MV_FRAME_DIAG is off by default and refused when packaged, and the production main/preload/renderer deliver and present frames across generations >= 2; needs Electron and xvfb.

e2e26 boots the shipped main.js, preload, hostBindings and renderer against a fixture core and proves take_control and release_control are acknowledged and journaled within 1 s while RGB24 frames stream at >= 2 fps; needs Electron and xvfb.
e2e27 proves window.metaviewer.input.send(batch) drives surface_input/v1 through the shipped preload against a fixture core; needs Electron and xvfb.
e2e2 proves a six-event replay equals an independently declared golden state twice, verify-only replay is silent, a corrupted journal refuses, and a budget mutant changes the digest.

e2e3 proves on the real core: an act bound to an old frame generation gets STALE_FRAME with no partial state; act after take_control gets SURFACE_NOT_AGENT_CONTROLLED and is admitted again after release_control; unknown vs destroyed ids give documented codes.
